name: bent arm chest stretch
description: Pressing a bent arm against a wall or frame stretches the chest and front shoulder. Changing the arm height shifts which part you feel.
instructions: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
